title: ui-confirm: create AntithesisInput component
description: Create an interactive AntithesisInput component that allows users to propose counter-arguments or alternative perspectives to the problem statement. This component is central to the confirm phase, enabling users to stress-test their problem definition by actively trying to disprove or challenge it.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a text input area for antithesis entry
THE SYSTEM SHALL support markdown formatting in antithesis input

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a user begins typing an antithesis
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide real-time character count and formatting assistance

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a user submits an antithesis
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL validate the input and store it for quality analysis

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the antithesis field loses focus
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL auto-save the current draft

unwanted.condition: IF the antithesis input exceeds maximum length
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT accept input beyond the limit
unwanted.because: excessively long inputs degrade performance and readability

unwanted.condition: IF invalid characters or scripts are detected
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT process potentially malicious content

preconditions: User must have an active session with edit permissions
The problem context must be loaded and available
postconditions: Submitted antithesis is stored and linked to the current problem
Input is sanitized and validated before storage
invariants: Antithesis content is never modified after submission without user action
Draft state is preserved across component re-renders

happy: Given an empty antithesis field, when user types valid text, then the input is captured and displayed
Given a completed antithesis, when user clicks submit, then the antithesis is saved and quality analysis is triggered
Given a partially filled form, when user navigates away and returns, then the draft is restored
error: Given an antithesis exceeding character limit, when user attempts to submit, then validation error is shown
Given a network failure, when user submits antithesis, then the system queues the submission for retry
Given invalid markdown syntax, when user submits, then the system provides helpful error feedback without crashing

phase_2: Create AntithesisInput component with 3 input fields for antithesis points

similar: See textarea components for input patterns
